analysis.description: 2-4 sentences: the genre family chosen and why, vocals or instrumental, the lyrics language, the target duration and the story angle

character.description: 3-6 energy, mood, era and attitude tags

genre.description: main genre and subgenre tags, comma-separated

key.description: musical key such as F minor, or an empty string

lyrics.description: section-marked lyrics, or an empty string for instrumentals

references.description: 0-3 tags of the form 'in the style of ...'

vocal_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the lyrics language: ru, en, uk, be, es, de, fr, it, pt, pl, tr, ja, ko, zh

vocal_style.description: one phrase describing the singer; empty for instrumentals
